```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggvenn)
library(ggbreak)

source('~/CRISPR-KO-GuideRefine/GuideRefine_functions.R')
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")
```

# Import data containing removed genes from each library

```{r}

removed_genes <- read_csv("../data/biogrid_crispr_ko_data/important_data/removed_genes_all_library.csv")

```

# Prepare data from BIOGRID

```{r}

biogrid_index <- read_tsv("../data/biogrid_crispr_ko_data/important_data/BIOGRID-ORCS-SCREEN_INDEX-2.0.18.index.tab.txt")

# we select CRISPR KO screen based on cell proliferation, library type is CRISPR knockout (CRISPRn), and containing list of full genes and their hits (full size available - yes)

# available library total:  37
# selected library:
# 1. Avana
# 2. Brunello (human)
# 3. Toronto Knockout version 3 (TKOv3)
# 4. None for Project Score

# create blank dataframe
df_avana_screen <- data.frame()

avana_screen_studies <- biogrid_index %>%
  filter(PHENOTYPE == "cell proliferation" & LIBRARY_TYPE == "CRISPRn" & FULL_SIZE_AVAILABLE == "Yes" & LIBRARY == "Avana") %>%
  pull(`#SCREEN_ID`)

test_crispr_ko <- read_tsv("../data/biogrid_crispr_ko_data/BIOGRID-ORCS-SCREEN_17-2.0.18.screen.tab.txt", col_names = FALSE, skip = 1)

for (screen_id in avana_screen_studies) {
  data = read_tsv(paste("../data/biogrid_crispr_ko_data/BIOGRID-ORCS-SCREEN_", screen_id, "-2.0.18.screen.tab.txt", sep = ""), col_names = FALSE, skip = 1)
  
  # X13 is column indicating whether the genes is the hits or not
  data <- data %>% filter(X13 == "YES")
  df_avana_screen = rbind(df_avana_screen, data)
}

colnames(df_avana_screen) <- c("SCREEN_ID", "IDENTIFIER_ID", "IDENTIFIER_TYPE", "OFFICIAL_SYMBOL", "ALIASES", "ORGANISM_ID", "ORGANISM_OFFICIAL", "SCORE.1", "SCORE.2", "SCORE.3", "SCORE.4", "SCORE.5", "HIT", "SOURCE")

```

# Check if the removed genes is in the CRISPR screen data

```{r}

test <- df_avana_screen %>% 
  filter(OFFICIAL_SYMBOL %in% removed_genes$avana_removed_genes_all) %>%
  count(OFFICIAL_SYMBOL) %>%
  dplyr::rename("count_appear_in_screen" = "n") %>%
  count(count_appear_in_screen) %>%
  dplyr::rename("num_genes" = "n")

test_2 <- df_avana_screen %>% 
  filter(OFFICIAL_SYMBOL %in% removed_genes$avana_removed_genes_all)

# next step = put the removed genes that never part of the hits in avana screen, and then create a binned bar chart similar to alignments


```
